
# **Tipping Study - pt.7 Model results**

---

Setup
---

#### Workspace

```{r}
if (!requireNamespace("here")) install.packages("here")
source(here::here("r", "utilities", "workspace.r"))

library(data.table)
library(mgcv)
library(emmeans)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
```

#### Data

```{r}
load(here::here("data", "proc", "06_out.rdata"))
```

Model summary & effects
---

#### Summary

```{r}
summary(m1)
```

#### Marginal means from full design

```{r}
emms_full <- emmeans(
  object = m1,
  specs = ~ distractor_effector * left_right_hand | effector_side
)

emms_full
```

#### interaction between palm/back-hand vs distractors' relative (to effector) position

```{r}
emms_hand <- emmeans(
  object = m1,
  specs = ~ effector_side * distractor_effector
)

emms_hand
```

#### simple effect of palm/back-hand

```{r}
emms_cong_by_es <- emmeans(
  object = m1,
  specs = ~effector_side
)

emms_cong_by_es
```

#### simple effect of distractors' relative positions

```{r}
emms_cong_by_de <- emmeans(
  object = m1,
  specs = ~distractor_effector
)

emms_cong_by_de
```

Plot interactions
---

#### Full design

```{r}
emmp <- emmip(
  object = emms_full,
  formula = effector_side ~ distractor_effector | left_right_hand,
  CIs = TRUE,
  dotarg = list(shape = "circle", size = 4),
  linearg = list(linetype = "solid", linewidth = 1)
) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 0,
    linetype = 2,
    colour = "goldenrod"
  ) +
  ylim(c(-5, 5)) +
  labs(
    # TODO: stop hard-coding white space like a barbarian
    y = "    PALMAR    Horizontal Drift (mm)    DORSAL    ",
    x = "Distractor/Effector Positioning"
  ) +
  scale_color_discrete(
    name = "Effector Side",
    breaks = c("Dorsal", "Palmar"),
    labels = c("Dorsal", "Palmar")
  )
```

#### palm/back-hand vs distractors' relative positions

```{r}
emmp_hand <- emmip(
  object = emms_hand,
  formula = effector_side ~ distractor_effector,
  CIs = TRUE,
  dotarg = list(shape = "circle", size = 4),
  linearg = list(linetype = "solid", linewidth = 1)
) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 0,
    linetype = 2,
    colour = "goldenrod"
  ) +
  ylim(c(-5, 5)) +
  labs(
    y = "    PALMAR    Horizontal Drift (mm)    DORSAL    ",
    x = "Distractor/Effector Positioning"
  ) +
  scale_color_discrete(
    name = "Effector Side",
    breaks = c("Dorsal", "Palmar"),
    labels = c("Dorsal", "Palmar")
  )
```

#### simple effect of palm/back-hand

```{r}
emmp_cong <- emmip(
```
